notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.3]
notes.notes:
Update contents:

notes.title: "Koi-Koi Japan : Hana-Awase Rule Add-On" DLC is out now on Steam!

"Table Game Bundle" include "Koi-Koi Japan [Hanafuda playing cards]",

For more about the game check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1491860/]here[/url].

notes.title: Japanese Table Game bundle released!
notes.notes:
We hope you have enjoyed playing Mahjong Nagomi. If you like Japanese table games then we have a new bundle for you!

◆[b]Table Game Bundle[/b] contains two of the most famous Japanese table games including:
・Koi-Koi Japan [Hanafuda playing cards]
・Mahjong Nagomi

Enjoy Japanese-style Mahjong and also Koi-Koi which is played with Japanese "[i]hanafuda[/i]" flower cards.  Both games support multiplayer mode so you can play against your friends and other players from all over the world.  Or if you prefer you can enjoy single player mode and practice your skills or compete against AI players.

Complete-the-set and get 15% off whichever game you don't already own.  Or if you haven't had a chance to try either game then pick up both at the same time and save!

For more information check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16135/Table_Game_Bundle/]Table Game Bundle[/url].

Please appreciate Japanese culture and have a great playing experience at the same time!

notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.2]
notes.notes:
Update contents:
* The function of meld off was changed to reset in round.
* Added English "romaji yaku" display.
* Added multiplayer records.
* Changed the multiplayer rules to "Win End".[Agari yame]
* Added a timer on/off setting in multiplayer friend matches.
* Fixed to release the lobby if the lobby owner leaves the room by matching.
* Added support for resolution change.
* A display guide for "winning" tiles was added.
* Other minor modifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302682/5bb6c53ba9efd927c4cbf271827717cdbd941a76.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated [ver1.0.1]
notes.notes:
Update contents:
* Added support for automatic discard after riichi.
* Added meld off function.
* Changed Chow/Pung/Kong to Chii/Pon/Kan in the English setting.
* A numbered tile was added. You can change them in the settings.
* Other minor modifications.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38302682/8bc3b6d6b4b208e0bc116cd5cca9c7f2c2bfd032.png[/img]

notes.title: "Mahjong Nagomi" is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
This isn't solitaire where you match tiles, this is the classic game.

Authentic Japanese Mahjong is played with 4 players and full online multiplayer support is included.
It's the most popular table game in Japan and now you can play online with your friends.

For more about the game check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356180/]here[/url].

Thank you!
